text_block_list.text: Summer training camp. An overnight intensive training camp held at a seaside facility to sharpen the horsegirls' skills—
............Or at least, that was the plan.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOO!!
Our adventure!! Starts right here, right now, baby!!

Instead of arriving at the seaside facility,
Gold Ship and I ended up in... the middle of a "forest."
Trying to calm my dizzying confusion, I desperately racked my brain to remember how we got here—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ripples! Ocean breezes! Arctic freezes!!
The sea is calling my name!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no!!
This ain't gonna cut it at ALLLL!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be the woods! Unless it's a forest where rhinos and stags duke it out over tree sap,
my latent superpowers will never awaken!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Follow me, Trainer!
We're changin' venues!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Got our boarding passes, got our playing cards, shogi, chess, and Go boards for the flight...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, didn't forget a thing! Let's roll!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeah!! Nothing but green as far as the eye can see!!
Our summer camp officially starts now!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let's head right into those woods over there and catch some bugggs~!!

Something wasn't right. We came for summer camp,
and yet here I was, trekking deep into the woods with Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, rainbow mushroom spotted!
Hey, hey, think we can eat that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, poisonous or not,
it's not like that's any big deal for folks like us!
Will we ever make it back in one piece...?

I'm Gold Ship's Trainer.
What good am I if I can't keep up with her free spirit?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, you've been awful quiet back there.
Our bug hunt's just getting started, you know?
choice_data_list: Let's go explore some ancient ruins instead, it'll be way more fun!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAAT!?!?
What's that about?! That sounds hype as hell!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hold up—*BEEP BEEP! BEEP BEEP! Golshi Radar picking up a signal!*
The ruins are that way!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer!
Time to hunt down undiscovered treasures, full steam aheeead!

Pushing through the dense forest trees,
our grand summer adventure with Gold Ship began—!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, a fork in the road.
Do we go right, or do we go left...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah... Gold Ship isn't the kind of horsegirl
who just settles for the options handed to her!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Charge straight through, Trainer!
We don't follow the path, the path forms behind us wherever we blaze through!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, WHOAAA~! That's a cliff ahead?!
I CAN'T STOOOOOP~~~~!!!!
The two of us went tumbling headlong down the overgrown, steep slope.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHAHA!!
Oh man, this is ridiculously fuuuun--!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*Pant, pant*... Man, running around that much
can wear out even the mighty Golshi-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You did pretty darn well keeping up with me though.
Not bad at all, partner.
choice_data_list: I am your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho!? Look at you, saying cool stuff!
Growing into a proper big shot, aren't ya!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here's a little present from me to you, then.
C'mon, take a look. See the sunset shimmering across the ocean—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This whole adventure, and this view right here.
This is what I've wanted to show you all along!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I literally just made that up on the spot, but hey.
Pretty sweet anyway, right?
The sea spreading out before us... with the setting sun sparkling across the waves, it almost looked like fans cheering us on during a Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep showing you all sorts of amazing sights from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So let's shoot for it together!
Becoming the ultimate treasure hunters...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, then let's dash toward the sunset for good measure!
A true horsegirl's gotta sprint whenever she sees a setting sun!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOO!!
HERE WE GOOOOO--!!

As always, I couldn't make heads or tails of what she was saying, but through this wild adventure...
I felt like Gold Ship and I had grown just a little closer.
choice_data_list: ...So, which way is the airport to go back?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: How the heck should I knooow?!
choice_data_list: ...I had a feeling you'd say that!!

text_block_list.text:
Completely at a loss,
we somehow, someway managed to find our way back to Tracen Academy...
